titles.romaji: Baja no Studio: Baja no Mita Umi
titles.english: Baja's Studio - Baja and the Sea -
titles.native: バジャのスタジオ ～バジャのみた海～

description:
New animation that will be included in a Blu-ray Disc Kyoto Animation is offering to those who pre-order tickets for its upcoming "We're Here Now!!: It's the First Festival in Two Years" fan event with Animation DO. Kyoto Animation will also offer the Blu-ray Disc for sale separately at a later date.

(Source: Anime News Network)
